decisions.reason: The revised popup restates the existing $5, $500-ticket, and random existing-holder behavior without changing the reward mechanism.
The source changes invalid-code feedback wording, not which referral codes are valid or the self-referral rule.
Badge layout is addressed by a separate clause in the same message and is unaffected by the referral-feedback wording change.
NFT sizing is addressed independently in the message; changing referral-feedback text does not alter cover-display requirements.
The client requests exact wording for the validation popup, not a change to FAQ content.
The revised message concerns invalid or absent codes and does not change rewards for successful coded referrals.
The wording change does not alter the use, permanence, or display locations of NFT mint numbers as referral codes.
The popup wording does not change dashboard accounting or display of commissions and prize tickets.
The source Event changes referral-feedback copy and does not modify the USDC wallet mint flow.
Mentioning a $500 prize-draw ticket in popup text does not change ticket counters, eligibility windows, or post-draw lifecycle.
The message restates the $5 commission and ticket outcome but does not change the established mint-price allocation.
The requested text is specifically for invalid-code validation feedback, not landing-page mechanics copy.
